paper_metadata.title: Influences of ruthenium and crystallographic orientation on creep behavior of aluminized nickel-base single crystal superalloys

evidence.quote: The influences of ruthenium and surface orientation on creep behavior of aluminized Ni-base single crystal superalloys were investigated by comparing two different types of NKH superalloys.
